methods.description: Admit only exact accepted checkpoint archive/locator custody to structural selected-data CI while preserving package/code exclusions, fixed archive validation, actual baseline selection and fresh scientific geography qualification. The existing API enforces optional caller-owned response-byte admission before JSON allocation.
methods.software: Node 24; Git; existing GitHub receipt/archive validators
methods.units: whole-file identities, complete path membership and current byte admission

limits: Structural CI eligibility does not mint checkpoint authority, approve geography or establish hosted A-to-B adoption.
Original accepted seed/scientific products and historical execution identities are unchanged.
Actual B hosted delivery remains required; ordinary full CI stays the fallback for unavailable or unsupported custody.
commands: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/selected-data-profile.test.mjs test/integration-profile-restoration.test.mjs test/github-quota.test.mjs test/github-admission.test.mjs test/github-snapshots.test.mjs test/issue-claim-quota.test.mjs
